<!-- pr-reviewer: 1db14b7ae6acfcfe11d5c80b86cbf642e22d56ce -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

This PR changes test code in `camcraft-ui`, rules text and one decision file. No product code changed. No snapshot PNG changed. It cannot change posted G-code, collision or gouge checks, stock simulation or geometry.

## What looks good
- 15 named `layout_*` tests in `page_layout.rs`. Each asserts a coarse law only, and a failure names the page.
- `assert_shell_skeleton` now asserts presence, labels and enabled state. The position clauses moved to `assert_shell_layout`. No coverage is lost.
- `anchors.rs` takes pointer targets from the live layout. It replaces the fixed points (4,4), (1100,500) and (640,712). `model_incomplete` finds the status node by its text.
- `panic!` appears only in test helpers. The new file has a provenance line and every new file is under 400 lines.
- Process files: the body says `Process change: yes`. `PROCESS_VERSION` is not edited. The body has `Changelog: none` and `Refs #1953`. The decision file is present.

## Results merged with main
Run locally, on the PR head merged with `origin/main` (the trial merge was clean), `-j 6`, `--test-threads=6`.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (cwd `crates/ui`) | 993 passed, 0 failed, 6 ignored (snapshot lane) |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

Not run: the full quick tier (the diff touches `AGENTS.md`, so it selects every suite) and the pixel lane (release tier). Both are outside this test-only change.

## Requested before merge
None.

## Notes (not blocking)
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs` is 5140 lines and grows by 4. It was over the limit before this PR. A split can be a follow-up.
- The merge-time refresh commit `1db14b7` is a merge of main. This review covers the whole PR head.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
